class.name: hhros2_controllers/HumanoidBaseController
class.description: Chainable 500 Hz base controller. Interpolates a hybrid (q, dq, tau, kp, kd) reference from the RL/WBC cores onto the HAL command interfaces.

class.name: hhros2_controllers/DampingController
class.description: Safe-reflex damping controller. Commands zero stiffness with fixed joint damping so the robot folds down gently on a Level 2 fault.

class.name: hhros2_controllers/PlatformJointStateBroadcaster
class.description: Publishes canonical joint state through the platform QoS contract.

class.name: hhros2_controllers/PlatformImuBroadcaster
class.description: Publishes ros2_control IMU state through the platform QoS contract.
